lab.passRange.coarse: 🔴 The grid was too fine, so it was sampled with a stride — the interval edges may be coarser than the real ones.

lab.passRange.none: 🔴 This control alone cannot reach a pass — other conditions have to change as well.
lab.passRange.noneAll: 🔴 Under the current conditions no single control can reach a pass on its own — two or more have to change together.

lab.scopeBlocked: {n} grid point(s) on this axis fall outside the operating limits; the curve is broken there rather than drawn. No values are invented.
lab.scopeDiscrete: 🔴 This x-axis is not continuous — only {n} values can be selected, so the {n} plotted points are all of them. Nothing exists between them.

lab.scopeNoData: Every point on this axis is outside the operating limits, so there is no curve to draw. Restore another parameter and try again.
lab.scopeNote: 🔴 All {n} points on the curve come from re-running the actual calculation model at that input. Nothing is interpolated or fitted.
